purpose: Opt-in Linux sandbox-runtime qualification pilot for one harmless scratch-file effect (backend/orchestrator/sandbox_qualification.py). Qualification only: no production launch path, schema, shared contract, component pin, or release artifact changes.

artifact.acquisition: Every exact lockfile tarball is downloaded only with explicit opt-in through shared.external_http, without redirects or environment proxies, bounded and SHA-512 verified before a private npm cache is seeded. Installation uses npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts with the committed package.json/package-lock.json; the real CLI --help must succeed without ambient modules.

linux_primitives: bubblewrap (bwrap) on PATH or pinned absolute path
socat on PATH or pinned absolute path
seccomp-BPF via the vendored apply-seccomp helper (vendor/seccomp/x64 and vendor/seccomp/arm64)

architecture_profile.documented_profile: ubuntu-24.04 on linux/amd64 or linux/arm64 with the distribution bubblewrap/socat/ripgrep packages, unprivileged user and network namespaces permitted by the host kernel and container runtime, and the vendor apply-seccomp binary; no host AppArmor or user-namespace policy is weakened for the pilot
architecture_profile.everything_else: reports unavailable and never launches an effect
architecture_profile.qualification: Requires retained real full-profile evidence on the exact candidate; declaration alone is not qualification.

upstream_warnings_treated_as_hard_failur: seccomp not available - unix socket access not restricted
apply-seccomp binary not available - unix socket blocking disabled

private_mount_adapter.policy: Seal each generated private tmpfs and /dev mount read-only after SRT setup; preserve the separately bound scratch directory, existing namespace and seccomp fences.
private_mount_adapter.configuration: Exclusive owner-only source and closed binary/scratch configuration, rechecked before every effect; unknown or malformed generated arguments fail closed.

boundaries.in_scope: One short-lived, no-network, harmless local scratch-file effect per verified receipt, launched through the existing ProcessSupervisor and the existing generated-executor LETS receipt verifier.
out_of_scope: provider egress through the SRT proxy
